mapper.select: SELECT a.flow_id, a.flow_name, a.flow_code, b.request_json FROM bt_skill_flow a LEFT JOIN bt_skill_flow_param b ON b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.flow_id = a.flow_id AND b.status_cd = '00A' WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND a.flow_id IN (#{id})
SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS existence FROM bt_skill_flow WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND flow_type = 'multiStep' AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND flow_id IN (#{id})
SELECT service_id, service_name, service_code, path_json, header_json, query_json, body_json FROM bt_skill_service WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND service_id IN (#{id})
SELECT service_id, service_name, service_code, req_json FROM bt_skill_sql WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND service_id IN (#{id})
SELECT func_id, func_name, func_code, req_json FROM bt_skill_function WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND func_id IN (#{id})
SELECT api_id, api_name, api_code, req_json FROM bt_skill_plugin WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND api_id IN (#{id})
SELECT page_id, page_name, page_code, req_param_json FROM bt_skill_page WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND page_id IN (#{id})
SELECT page_func_id, func_name, func_code, req_json FROM bt_skill_page_func WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id IN (#{tenantId}, -1) AND page_func_id IN (#{id})
SELECT knowledge_id, knowledge_name FROM bt_knowledge_base WHERE status_cd = '00A' AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND knowledge_id IN (#{id})
